audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: Lux out-ranges and pokes 1-6, first item is a skill check, Veigar owns two-plus items. WR 54.74 over 2872 games (Veigar) matches the scaling profile — she wins lane, he wins game; the packet's chart-vs-WR defect note is explained by that split.

All four content spikes present and grounded: her 3-5 Q-E poke, her level 6 Final Spark execute, Veigar's first-item cage-flip, his 2+ item one-shot. Packet's suspectName 'Her Final Spark' is a false positive — Final Spark is the real R name; the leading 'Her' tripped the matcher.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart rows 0-4 said 'Skill' while content win[] and packet say Lux; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; the Illumination auto-reset burst tell was unmentioned; enemyWin half-templated; 19 misgender hits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat, minion-blocked, 1175 range; Final Spark is 60/50/40s so it is nearly always up past 6; her combo finishes with an Illumination-proc auto, making the wind-up the step-back cue; Prismatic Barrier shields but Primordial Burst's execute math still clears a sub-half Lux.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 moved to Lux with grounded whys and ratings (win[] already agrees — side-only per the chart rule); cooldowns rewritten with 10s/60-40s/20s; Illumination tell written into dontsFull[2].d; bleed bullets replaced.
